observability_triage.rationale: Help persistence can be tested without trusting application configuration by clearing only each control's editable content in a temporary DOCX copy, then verifying its w:tag, w:alias, placeholder reference, and resolved placeholder text remain intact.

acceptance_criteria.statement: After editable content is removed from each interactive content control in a temporary DOCX copy, that control retains its unique tag, non-empty alias/help label, valid placeholder reference, and non-empty resolved placeholder text.

setup: Copy the built DOCX to a temporary path.
Record tag, alias, placeholder relationship, and resolved placeholder text for each interactive control.

parameters.mutation: remove editable descendants of w:sdtContent while preserving w:sdtPr and package relationships

expected_observations.subject: post-clear controls with missing or blank help metadata

determinism_controls: Mutate a temporary package and preserve ZIP member names and relationships.
Resolve placeholders from OOXML package parts; do not accept source configuration or custom model prose as behavioral evidence.

setup: Clearing a field removes its only instruction text and it has no persistent alias/placeholder.
negative_cases.action: Clear the field in the temporary package and resolve retained metadata.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails for the now-unidentifiable field.
